findings.pdf_says: Figure E.3 — Compilation group and run unit structures: a drawn diagram of nested boxes (a thick-bordered compilation group holding three compilation units; the middle one a source unit P-1 containing source elements P-1-1 and P-1-2, with P-1-2 containing P-1-2-1 and P-1-2-2), arrows labelled "To other run unit" and "From other comp. group", a lower thick-bordered run unit with runtime modules and dashed runtime elements mirroring the upper structure, and a Legend mapping border styles to Compilation Group, Compilation Unit, Source Unit, Source Element, Run Unit, Runtime Module, Runtime Element.

findings.why_it_matters: The figure was reduced to a scatter of its text labels (legend entries interleaved with box labels, the arrow captions turned into a two-row table). The nesting that the figure exists to show (which source elements sit in which source unit, and how compilation units map onto runtime modules in a run unit) and the legend's border-style key are lost. Annex E is informative, so no normative rule is affected.
